name: Oskarn Station 14 GEO-StatisticsAddition

Its remaining stated figures are calibration interval 8 months, reducing maintenance frequency by 40% compared to previous models, unit price set after acceptance, mounting handheld, a format preferred by 68% of field researchers. Every one of them is quoted from the same six axes the other listings in this category are described on.
